notes.title: Updated on August 22nd
notes.notes:
[olist]
The bullet rebound of the Launcher weapon has been changed to full map tracking, and if the target is not aimed when firing, it will automatically track the nearest enemy on the screen. And the bullets will follow the enemy's movements.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on July 25th
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added Epic Weapon Temporary Launcher, supporting bullet rebound tracking function. When the energy bullet fired by the left button hits obstacles such as the ground or walls, it can bounce back and automatically track enemies within a range of 6 meters. The energy bomb can bounce up to 3 times. Acquisition method: Purchase and unlock.
[/list]

notes.title: Updated on June 28th
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Add new unlockable motorcycles
[*] Increased the engine sound effects of motorcycle vehicles
[*] Tower defense can place traps and raise them up
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated April 29
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added the Q key to switch the aiming device in the game
[*] The motorcycle unlocking adjustment is increased, and the summoned motorcycle is immune to terrain collision damage and has unlimited fuel.
[*] Added the effect of colliding with zombies to trigger the limb breaking effect for motorcycles and cars.
[/list]

notes.title: Updated April 25
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added optional high-power scopes to most weapons
[*] Added a bolt-action sniper: Mosin-Nagant
[*] Added unlockable motorcycles, and the unlocking tokens will be increased after the next update.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated April 19
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added bicycle vehicles and summoning props. Displayed under the warehouse's full list. Bicycles support two seats, and the player in the back seat can shoot.
[*] Bicycle summoning props can be purchased and unlocked or dropped by passing the third level of difficult epic.
[*] After equipping the summoning prop, press B in the game to summon. If the bicycle already exists, it will not be refreshed again and will only be teleported in front of the character.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated April 15
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The training ground console interface has been adjusted, a vehicle spawning button has been added, and the monster spawning input interface has been optimized. The console interface does not support multiple languages. Press the "/" key to open the console.
[*] If the vehicle cannot be spawned, it is usually due to obstacles. You can adjust the character's position to ensure that there are no obstacles in front of the character.
[*] The training ground does not have much gameplay, and it is mainly used to test performance in development mode. Features Manual control to continuously and infinitely spawn zombies, infinitely modify attributes, infinitely spawn vehicles, unlimited rockets at any firing rate, and arbitrarily spawn hundreds or thousands of zombies until the computer freezes and crashes, etc.
[/list]

notes.title: Updated April 7
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Reload volume is now affected by overall volume.
[*] Graphics quality changed from epic to medium when first opening the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated April 5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Greatly reduce the HP of common zombies in difficult and epic difficulty.
[*] The easy and normal difficulty of levels 2~3 can be unlocked without prior clearance.
[*] Provide a game save file to reduce the liver, 4 additional equipment have been unlocked, initial 10,000 tokens, talent level 21. The equipment enhancement information will be overwritten. It is recommended to use the save file to purchase the AR4 rifle and enhance it to level 20. [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ckcxaMjTjd93PZ32ey2o_8i_Ifz7pGEU/view?usp=drive_link]Save file[/url] Overwrite to C:\Users\{USER_NAME}\AppData\Local\MutantCrisis\Saved\SaveGames
[/list]

notes.title: Updated March 7
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a new limb-breaking effect. Now limb-breaking will affect the zombie's movement. Currently only implemented in level 1.
[*] Added a limb-breaking switch in the language and miscellaneous settings. It is turned on by default. If it is turned off, it will not trigger the actual limb-breaking effect, but will only affect the movement.
[/list]

notes.title: Updated on January 28
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Packaging method adjusted to support DLC and other expansions
[*] Notice that the tower defense DLC will be available online for free as the final content
[/list]

notes.title: Updated on January 12
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] In the story mode, random attribute enhancements are added, and there is no upper limit for the attribute enhancements. Now the more attributes you gain in the game, the easier it is to defeat the level BOSS.
[/list]

notes.title: New map Lost City is online
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added the Lost City level, a semi-open map, currently only open to the simple and normal modes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018916/72c74693e9d4fa009e914f10701ce416d5eb6abb.png[/img]
[*] Added a new monster, the self-destructing spider, to the Lost City. It will self-destruct when approaching the player, so be careful to avoid it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018916/93dbde626c073cc47a4fa409bc72d913d63dd06c.png[/img]
[*] Added the epic weapon laser rifle, which needs to be unlocked after clearing the hard mode of the Dune Base and reaching talent level 20.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018916/dd405d451472b84f0719bcd4c599ce7747e46454.png[/img]
[*] In the next version, random buffs will be updated in the game. They will be dropped by killing monsters or looted to increase temporary attributes, reducing the difficulty of single-player boss challenges.
[*] The double-clicking the direction key to roll in four directions has been cancelled, and the ALT key is used to roll forward.
[/list]

notes.title: Updated on December 11th
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added minimap and map preview: mouse wheel to zoom minimap, M key for map preview.
[*] The settings menu miscellaneous items have been added to whether to display the minimap and whether the minimap is displayed as a circle/square setting.
[*] Fixed the problem that some additional equipment cannot be hidden in the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on November 27
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added three equipment items: pumpkin helmet, ring, and backpack. The bracelet is adjusted to be exclusively dropped at the station. The pumpkin helmet drops on Death Island. The ring and backpack drop at the dune base. The above drops are only dropped with a probability of being cleared on difficult or epic difficulty. Equipment items increase the initial gold, health, attack power, and defense attributes respectively.
[*] The pumpkin helmet adds a P key skill, which increases the critical hit rate and critical hit damage for a short period of time.
[*] When the four additional equipments of helmet, bracelet, ring, and backpack are equipped at the same time, the Z key skill is unlocked. When the Z skill is released, the group critical hit rate is increased, and the active releaser increases the additional critical hit damage by 100%. Only one player is allowed to release the Z skill at the same time, and other teammates will enter a short interval.
[*] The appearance of hidden equipment in the game is currently not available.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on November 16
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added 4 additional equipment slots for helmets, bracelets, rings, and backpacks. 4 new equipment will be displayed in the lower left corner of the warehouse. A new ALL type filter box will be added to display all equipment. Check the box on the equipment slot to show or hide the appearance of the equipment in the game. Currently, additional equipment can only be obtained through drops, and enhancement is not supported yet.
[*] Added bracelet drops in all maps in the story mode, which require a certain probability of dropping after clearing the difficult and epic modes. The current drop probability is high; the probability will be lowered later and the drops in different maps will also be different. The equipment name will be displayed when the drop is obtained in the settlement interface, and the warehouse will unlock the equipment afterwards.
[*] The bracelet attributes are tentatively scheduled to increase the starting money and maximum health.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on November 1
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added armed helicopters, left mouse button for machine guns, right mouse button for missiles.
[*] Hit sound effects
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on October 23
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Zombies have added single-leg hopping and crawling actions
[*] Vehicles have added smoke effects when their health drops to zero, and explosion effects. Vehicle explosions increase damage to surrounding characters.
[*] Optimized the effect of zombies chasing vehicles, and now zombies will surround vehicles and attack
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on October 14th
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Three vehicles are added to level 1, in the parking space at the rear of the station. Before the BOSS battle, you will be forced to exit the vehicle. After the vehicle's health reaches zero, it will explode and kill all passengers in the car after a few seconds. The vehicle will cause damage to all characters while driving and will not be immune to team damage. The explosion details are not yet available. Passengers can shoot freely in the vehicle, but the driver cannot shoot.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on October 9
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the occasional crash when a large number of AIs are generated in the training ground to attack players
[*] Added armored vehicles with machine guns
[*] Fixed the problem of no gunfire due to too fast firing rate
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on October 3
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added training ground mode, the entrance is in single player mode->Training, the training ground mode has no experience and is only used to test performance and experience. Later, the training ground will be moved to the online lobby to wait for the map. If you die in the training ground, you can only press rebirth in the console interface. Note that if the rebirth point is occupied by a character, the rebirth will fail.
[*] Added console interface is only available in the training ground mode. Press the "/" key to call out the cheat mode. To spawn monsters, press the console to start the game. Enter the number of monsters in the input box below. The selection box in front is to keep the number of monsters. Note that it is currently known that the training ground will occasionally crash after being attacked by zombies. The console control is not translated yet.
[*] Added vehicles, currently only available in the training ground.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on September 21
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added a switch button for rolling, and the Alt key switches whether to turn on rolling
[*] Optimized some model collisions in the first level
[*] Added an epic weapon pre-experience version, the weapon codename is RifleA, and the probability of temporarily placing the random weapon in the in-game store for purchase will be adjusted to about 15% later. The left mouse button is an energy bullet, the right mouse button releases a device with continuous range damage, and the V key is a large-scale damage;
[previewyoutube=-ZqNJVYFoeU;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] When the in-game store draws an already held weapon, the ammunition will be superimposed, and no new weapons will be generated. Note that the weapons drawn from the store do not support ammunition replenishment and have no enhancement level. The drawn weapons need to be switched manually by pressing 1.
[*] The settlement token and talent point income will be increased.
[*] Exiting the game midway in a non-online state will also increase the income settlement.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on September 15th
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Add more weapon skins
[*] Add sound effects settings to the settings menu, currently supports 4 types: music, character, environment, UI. See feedback adjustment later.
[*] Add screen magnification in aiming state, currently the magnification speed and magnification are unified.
[*] Add support for weapon sights, add a sight option menu to the right of the preview when equipping supported weapons. The sights do not need to be unlocked, currently there are mechanical sights, red dots, and high-power scopes. High-power scopes support domestic magnification.
[*] The threshold of the double-click button for rolling has been changed from 0.25 seconds to 0.2 seconds. The actual test can greatly reduce the probability of accidental touch. If you think it is still easy to accidentally touch, consider adding a switch button, or if you have better suggestions.
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on September 12
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added face-pinching function for characters. Since the face-pinching parameters of each model are inconsistent, all native face-pinching parameters are opened. Currently, only some characters support partial body parameter customization. Press the face-pinching button to switch the face-pinching parameter display, and press the reset button to clear all face-pinching parameters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018916/3f2fcf3d640e88b45d5fa982dcf4778f742b32cf.png[/img]
[*] Preview is available when the character is not unlocked
[*] Added skin-changing function for equipment. Currently, only KA47's skin-changing is open. More equipment skins will be added later. Unlocked skins will not be saved in reverse archives. You need to click the amount part button to unlock before you can save the selected skin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018916/51be8800df6e8c97bd3b18e672862a0e50776ffc.png[/img] [/olist]

notes.title: Updated on September 9
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added rolling action, double-click the direction key to trigger
[*] Added sound effects for injury and death of characters
[*] Screen vibration is turned off by default when firing
[/olist]

notes.title: Updated on September 6
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Add action and dance buttons, press the middle mouse button to call them out
[*] Lowered the health of the boss at the bus station in hard mode
[*] Reduced the unlocking amount of SMG submachine gun
[/olist]
